dt2.11:1.2: magga-saccena ye dhammā khandha-saṃgahena saṃgahītā āyatana-saṃgahena saṃgahītā dhātu-saṃgahena saṃgahītā te dhammā katīhi khandhehi katīhāyatanehi katīhi dhātūhi sampayuttā?
dt2.11:1.3: Te dhammā tīhi khandhehi ekenāyatanena sattahi dhātuhi sampayuttā
dt2.11:1.4: ekena khandhena ekenāyatanena ekāya dhātuyā kehici sampayuttā.
dt2.11:1.6: Ekena khandhena dasahāyatanehi dasahi dhātūhi vippayuttā
dt2.11:1.7: ekenāyatanena ekāya dhātuyā kehici vippayuttā. Dhātuk_XI.2
dt2.11:2.2: purisindriyena ye dhammā khandha-saṃgahena saṃgahītā āyatana-saṃgahena saṃgahītā dhātu-saṃgahena saṃgahītā te dhammā katīhi khandhehi katīhāyātanehi katīhi dhātūhi sampayuttā ti?
dt2.11:2.5: Catuhi khandhehi ekenāyatanena sattahi dhātuhi vippayuttā
dt2.11:2.6: ekenāyatanena ekāya dhātuyā kehici vippayuttā. Dhātuk_XI.3
dt2.11:3.4: Domanassindriyena ye dhammā khandha-saṃgahena saṃgahītā āyatana-saṃgahena saṃgahītā dhātu-saṃgahena saṃgahītā
dt2.11:3.5: te dhammā . . . pe . . . . Tīhi khandhehi ekenāyatanena sattahi dhātūhi sampayuttā
dt2.11:3.8: Ekena khandhena dasahāyatanehi dasahi dhātūhi vippayuttā
dt2.11:4.1: Dhātuk_XI.4 Upekhindriyena ye dhammā khandha-saṃgahena saṃgahītā āyatana-saṃgahena saṃgahītā dhātu-saṃgahena saṃgahītā
dt2.11:4.2: te dhammā . . . pe . . . Tīhi khandhehi ekenāyatanena dvīhi dhātūhi sampayuttā
dt2.11:4.5: Ekena khandhena dasahāyatanehi paṇṇarasahi dhātūhi vippayuttā
dt2.11:4.6: ekenāyatanena ekāya dhātuyā kehici vippayuttā. Dhātuk_XI.5
dt2.11:5.14: Kammabhavena ye dhammā khandha-saṃgahena saṃgahītā āyatana-saṃgahena saṃgahītā dhātu-saṃgahena saṃgahītā te dhammā . . . pe . . . . Tīhi khandhehi ekenāyatanena sattahi dhātūhi sampayuttā
dt2.11:5.15: ekena khandhena ekenāyatanena ekāya dhātuyā kehici sampayuttā.
dt2.11:5.17: Ekena khandhena dasahi āyatanehi dasahi dhātūhi vippayuttā
dt2.11:5.18: ekenāyatanena ekāya dhātuyā kehici vippayuttā. Dhātuk_XI.6
dt2.11:6.1: Paridevena ye dhammā khandha-saṃgahena saṃgahītā āyatana-saṃgahena saṃgahītā dhātu-saṃgahena saṃgahītā te dhammā katīhi khandhehi katīhi āyatanehi katīhi dhātūhi sampayuttā ti?
dt2.11:6.4: Catuhi khandhehi ekenāyatanena sattahi dhātūhi vippayuttā
dt2.11:6.5: ekenāyatanena ekāya dhātuyā kehici vippayuttā. Dhātuk_XI.7
dt2.11:7.3: Domanassena ye dhammā khandha-saṃgahena saṃgahītā āyatanasaṃgahena saṃgahītā dhātu-saṃgahena saṃgahītā
dt2.11:7.4: te dhammā . . . pe . . . . Tīhi khandhehi ekenāyatanena sattahi dhātūhi sampayuttā
